test.create_query: CREATE TABLE final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged (c1 String, c2 String, c4 String, c5 DateTime, c6 String, c7 UInt8) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(c5, c7) PARTITION BY c4 ORDER BY (c1, c2, c4)
CREATE ROW POLICY OR REPLACE final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged_policy ON final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged USING c2 = concat('def', substring(currentUser(), 1, 0)) TO ALL
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged SELECT toString(cityHash64(number)), if(number % 500 = 0, 'def', toString(number % 997)), ['a','b','c','d'][number % 4 + 1], toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + number, concat('{{"p":{{"tags":["x","', if(number % 7 = 0, 'tag1', 'y'), '"],"t":"', repeat('z', 600), '"}}}}'), 0 FROM numbers(1500000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 375000, max_insert_block_size = 375000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged SELECT toString(cityHash64(number)), if(number % 500 = 0, 'def', toString(number % 997)), ['a','b','c','d'][number % 4 + 1], toDateTime('2026-03-01 00:00:00') + number, concat('{{"p":{{"tags":["x","', if(number % 3 = 0, 'tag1', 'y'), '"],"t":"', repeat('z', 600), '"}}}}'), 0 FROM numbers(750000, 1500000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 375000, max_insert_block_size = 375000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

SELECT throwIf(count() != 32 OR uniqExact(partition_id) != 4 OR min(rows) != 93750 OR max(rows) != 93750 OR max(level) != 1,'final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged: expected 32 unmerged parts of 93750 rows') FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 'final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged' AND active
test.query: SELECT count() FROM final_row_policy_query_constant FINAL WHERE has(JSONExtract(c6, 'p', 'tags', 'Array(String)'), 'tag1')
SELECT count() FROM final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged FINAL WHERE has(JSONExtract(c6, 'p', 'tags', 'Array(String)'), 'tag1')
test.drop_query: DROP ROW POLICY IF EXISTS final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged_policy ON final_row_policy_query_constant_unmerged
